class_desc.shinobi: Deflect first, cut second. The widest parry window there is.
class_desc.ronin: An odachi and no lord. Slow, heavy, and it goes through armour.
class_desc.assassin: Twin blades. Nothing you cut stops bleeding on its own.
class_desc.lancer: Reach is the whole plan. Nothing gets close enough to matter.
class_desc.monk: The holy path. Wounds close on their own; the cursed burn at your touch.
class_desc.onmyoji: The cursed path. It feeds on the blood you spill, then on yours.
class_desc.kyudoka: Bow and crossbow. Steadier aim, tighter recoil, one breath per shot.
class_desc.bulwark: Shield and short sword. You do not dodge. You absorb.

class_desc.shinobi: Önce savuştur, sonra kes. En geniş parry aralığı.
class_desc.ronin: Bir odachi, efendisizlik. Yavaş, ağır, zırhı deler.
class_desc.assassin: İkiz bıçak. Kestiğin yara kendiliğinden durmaz.
class_desc.monk: Kutsal yol. Yaralar kendi kapanır, lanetliler eline yanar.
class_desc.onmyoji: Lanetli yol. Döktüğün kanla beslenir, sonra seninkiyle.
class_desc.kyudoka: Yay ve arbalet. Sağlam nişan, dar geri tepme, atış başına tek nefes.
class_desc.bulwark: Kalkan ve kısa kılıç. Kaçmazsın, emersin.
